failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month_start,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m18.month_start)::int AS month,
       m18.order_count - m17.order_count AS growth
FROM monthly_counts m18
JOIN monthly_counts m17
  ON EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m18.month_start) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m17.month_start)
 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m17.month_start) = 2017
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m18.month_start) = 2018
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;

failures.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name,
       r.region_name,
       b.brand_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS product_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = p.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

failures.question: 默认收货地址所在州和客户登记州是否一致的订单量对比，列出前 20。

       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE sa.state = c.customer_state) AS same_state_orders,
